brief_summary: Horizontal bar chart comparing months in market as of September 2026 for three Hall-effect and magnetic boards: Wooting 60HE at roughly 53 months (mass production since April 2022), Keychron Q1 HE 8K at roughly 5 months (reviewers' hands since April 2026), and Keychron Q16 HE 8K at zero months, marked as a Kickstarter preorder that had not shipped as of its September 2026 campaign opening.
data_sources: data/boards/wooting-60he.json:releasedAt — '2022-04-01', description — 'Entered mass production in April 2022 and remains the fixed point reviewers measure newer HE and TMR boards against for rapid-trigger tuning depth and configurator maturity.'
data/boards/keychron-q1-he.json:releasedAt — '2026-04-01', description — 'The HE variant reached reviewers in April 2026 as the headline SKU of the Q Ultra launch.'

warnings: Months-in-market figures (~53, ~5, 0) are calculated from the cited releasedAt dates against the article's September 2026 publish window, not independently published vendor figures.
